title: Become a Simulator expert
description:
Simulator runs your iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, or watchOS apps directly on your Mac — no separate device required. We’ll give you a tour of the app's latest tools and features and show you how to sharpen your Simulator skills. Discover how to test pointer and trackpad support, adjust Simulator preferences, and use command line tools like simctl to help you simulate push notifications in a development environment.

While you can get a quick overview of Simulator in this session, for more detailed information about the tool you may want to refresh yourself on “Getting the Most Out of Simulator” from WWDC19.

codeSnippets.title: Grant permission to protected resources
codeSnippets.code:
xcrun simctl privacy booted grant calendar com.example.MyApp

xcrun simctl privacy booted grant photos com.example.MyApp

xcrun simctl privacy booted grant contacts com.example.MyApp

codeSnippets.title: Revoke permission to protected resources
codeSnippets.code:
xcrun simctl privacy booted revoke calendar com.example.MyApp

xcrun simctl privacy booted revoke all com.example.MyApp

xcrun simctl privacy booted reset all

codeSnippets.title: Sample push notification for Simulator
Send a push notification to a specific Bundle ID
codeSnippets.code: xcrun simctl push booted com.example.MyApp payload.json

codeSnippets.title: Send a push notification to the Bundle ID in the payload
Record a video
codeSnippets.code: xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo video.mp4

codeSnippets.title: Record a video in H.264 without the device mask
codeSnippets.code: xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec h264 --mask ignored video.mp4

codeSnippets.title: Record a video of the external display
codeSnippets.code: xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --display external external.mp4

codeSnippets.title: Override the status bar
codeSnippets.code: xcrun simctl status_bar booted override --time 12:01 --cellularBars 1 --dataNetwork 3g --wifiMode failed

codeSnippets.title: Add a certificate to the root store
codeSnippets.code: xcrun simctl keychain booted add-root-cert myCA.pem
